method: Each 0.05 degree grid cell is given to the district that contains its centre, and the district's monthly count from the sensor its province uses that month is multiplied by the province's own conversion for that month (province H divided by the province's raw count from that sensor). District values are a share-out of the province record, not a separate harmonization, and they are approximate near district borders.
unit: fire cell-days (0.01 deg cell x local date x satellite x day/night)

definitions.H: district raw count of the province's sensor_used x (province H / province raw count of that sensor); 0 when the province raw count is 0, which includes the months where the province row has H null and sensor_used null because no satellite saw fire anywhere in the province (sensor_used stays null there); null only in the locked months; rounded to 2 decimals
definitions.baseline_median: median of the district's H over the same calendar month, 2003 to 2022 (the bundle's definition), on the rounded H
definitions.pct_rank: rank of H among the same calendar month of earlier years, ties count half, null when there is no earlier year (the bundle's definition), on the rounded H; with many zero months the rank of a zero is the share of ties, not a sign of fire
definitions.flags: flag_nrt and flag_partial are copied from the province row; obs_class and agreement are null (not computed)
definitions.mean_cell_days_per_year: mean yearly sum of H over the complete calendar years 2001 to 2025 (years with a null month are skipped; years_in_mean says how many were used); low_data is true below 50

boundaries.source: geoBoundaries gbOpen IDN ADM2 (simplified), boundary id IDN-ADM2-22746128, build 12 Dec 2023, from Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS), World Food Programme and OCHA ROAP; www.geoboundaries.org
boundaries.licence_note: geoBoundaries metadata for IDN ADM2 gbOpen gives 'Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY 3.0 IGO)' for the boundary data; the geoBoundaries database itself is published under CC BY 4.0
boundaries.province_layer: geoBoundaries gbHumanitarian IDN ADM1 (CC BY 3.0 IGO), the layer of the bundle's province records; a district belongs to the province it overlaps most

locked.note: For these districts the rows of these months have null H, H_lo, H_hi, raw counts and pct_rank: a registered test of a sibling project locks Central Kalimantan and Pulang Pisau for 1 January to 31 October 2019, so nothing was computed. Their baseline and ranks leave 2019 out for January to October. The province record still has those months.

unit_check.what: national grid sums against monthly_IDN.json, every month

grid_check_note: Grid cells summed per province (through the districts) against the province file's raw column, month by month. max_abs_pct_diff is the largest monthly difference over months with at least 100 province cell-days; total_pct_diff compares the sums over all months. The differences come from 0.05 degree cells that straddle a province border and from the two boundary layers (gbOpen ADM2 here, gbHumanitarian ADM1 in the bundle). Districts add up to their province to within this difference.

definition_check.what: this script's baseline_median and pct_rank applied to the province H series against the values in the province files (Kalimantan Tengah left out)

excluded_units.why: units of the ADM2 layer that are lakes, reservoirs or a forest polygon, not a kabupaten or kota; a grid cell centred on one goes to the nearest district within 0.05 degree or is left out
